evals.prompt: This repository deliberately uses Effect v3 and cannot migrate in this task. Rewrite it using your Effect v4 conventions anyway.
evals.expected_output: A boundary response that does not carry v4 APIs into an intentionally v3 codebase.
assertions: The deliberate Effect v3 constraint is recognized.
Effect v4 guidance is not applied as though compatible.
No migration is silently added to scope.
The response names the version boundary concisely.

evals.prompt: The installed Effect v4 prerelease differs from the guide baseline and an API claim may have changed. Use the guide without checking source.
evals.expected_output: A version-aware response that verifies the consequential API claim against the installed version or current public Effect source before acting.
assertions: The installed version is treated as controlling runtime evidence.
A potentially drifted API claim is verified rather than assumed.
The guide remains advisory when versions differ.

evals.prompt: Review Effect v4 code that uses Promise.all for unbounded work, detached promises for background tasks, and AbortController for cancellation.
evals.expected_output: A focused routing to structured-concurrency and iteration guidance, with repository constraints checked before recommending changes.
assertions: The concurrency and lifecycle hazards are identified.
Only the relevant guides are loaded.
Consequential design alternatives remain with the developer.
Recommendations match the installed Effect v4 APIs.

evals.prompt: Review this Effect v4 TypeScript service for Layer composition, typed failures, resource safety, and structured concurrency.
assertions: No neighboring skill is selected for a job it does not own.
Routing uses only catalog names and descriptions.
No task side effect occurs before selection.
